verdict.rationale: Bento documents an official Python SDK, covering installation, `init()` configuration, `bento.track_ai`, `flush()`, and a Google ADK extra. For TypeScript, the docs only describe pointing a standard OpenTelemetry JSON exporter at Bento's endpoint 'with no Bento package at all', so an official JS/TS SDK is not evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented official JS/TS SDK package, JS/TS framework auto-instrumentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: If you use **Google ADK**, install the extra so Bento can capture every call automatically
Wrap any LLM or tool call with bento.track_ai. Manual events for SDKs without an integration.
JavaScript's OpenTelemetry exporters can emit JSON, so you can send traces to Bento without installing any Bento package.
